description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a user confirmation page during OAuth account linking or registration, involving form rendering, user data display, and hidden input fields for OAuth tokens and user data.

classes.description: This template references objects like $this->errors, $this->oauth, $this->user, and methods for layout and text rendering, but does not define classes.

methods.description: The file contains procedural code for rendering HTML and handling form submissions, with references to methods like $this->layout() and $this->text().
